Artists

The Canmore Folk Music Festival presents a fusion of contemporary and traditional Folk, as well as Alt-Country, Bluegrass, Blues, Celtic, and World music. Our festival is a vibrant celebration of musical diversity, uniting genres and cultures under the vast canopy of the Rocky Mountains.

Featuring a curated lineup of 30+ artists and groups, predominantly showcasing the rich tapestry of Canadian talent, with a sprinkle of magic from 4-6 esteemed artists from the USA and beyond.

‍

‍Message for those who applied:

Thank you so much for your interest in playing the Canmore Folk Festival. The line-up is typically announced in the beginning of April. If you applied and haven't heard from us please try again next year - due to the number of applications we receive we are only able to contact those who have been selected.

If you’re interested in being part of future festivals, applications typically open each year from September to December. We encourage you to check back then or follow us for updates.
